title: Unexpected highlight - visit here!
text:
Go to this place. 

We decided to visit following a review online and we are SO glad we did. This is an excellent attraction, and offers a quieter visit than some of the other sites. Well preserved history and stunning architecture. There are numerous buildings you can visit and even an underground tunnel. We did the audio tour, but you could go without as there are signs everywhere.
author: K6571ADcharlottev

title: A wonder not to be missed
text:
Anyone visiting the Sagrada Família should continue the Modernist Path and take the pleasant Gaudi Avenue to this “city inside the city”. The public Hospital of the Holy Cross and Saint Paul was founded in the beginning of the 15 C. in a different location. This one was built between 1902-1930, by Domenech I Montaner and his son Domenech I Roura. It worked as a hospital until 2006 and opened to the public in 2014; it was my first visit, long awaited.

title: Architect had a love for the sick
text: As a UNESCO World Heritage site this hospital's amazing structure with an interesting history is well taken care of. This Catalan architect had such a love for the sick of this world. Enjoyed learning the history. So happy we got this tour. Self Guided audio tour was hard to follow but still learned something. Entrance tickets were reasonable.
author: MominOC

title: Sant Pau Hospital, a Beautiful Place.
text: Absolutely stunning place, outstanding architecture and history, a must see for anyone visiting Barcelona, i have no words good enough to describe this beautiful place. Great location, Metro not too far, and you can see the Familia Sagrada out the window to save you the bother of visiting it. Make sure yiu.look up as the ceilings are world class.
author: adesallery

title: Marvelous Modernista!
text: No crowds and beautiful architecture!  Interesting to see work from Montaner, a contemporary/mentor of Gaudi in the Catalan Modernisme movement combined with practical uses.  Very nice exhibits and inspiring mosaics.  Explore the large campus at your leisure.
